name: french-reading-studio
description: Content foundation for learning French through public-domain literature.

scripts.build: npm run build:domain && npm run build:delivery && npm run build:app
scripts.content:build: npm run build && node dist/cli/prepare-fixtures.js && node dist/cli/plan-lievre.js && node dist/cli/build-corbeau.js && node dist/cli/build-lievre.js && node dist/cli/process-zola.js
scripts.content:check: npm run content:build && git diff --exit-code -- content
scripts.pipeline:zola: npm run build:domain && node dist/cli/plan-zola.js && node dist/cli/review-zola.js && node dist/cli/report-zola-coverage.js && node dist/cli/report-zola-editorial-batches.js && node dist/cli/process-zola.js
